Why Ilmora

Built like a real publication — not a PDF dump

Every title is written, referenced and laid out by hand, then checked against the Qur'an, Sahihayn, Sunan and Seerah sources.

✦ Sourced & referenced

Every hadith and story carries its source — Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim and named references. Weak or unverified claims are flagged honestly.

🌐 Four languages together

Uthmani Arabic with Urdu, Hinglish and English side by side — so the whole family can read along.

🖨 Print-ready A4 layout

Clean A4 pages, generous line spacing and tracker grids designed to be printed at home or read on a phone.

♾ Buy once, keep forever

No subscription, no sign-in wall. Your library stays under Digital Store → My Library and can be re-downloaded anytime.

Adhan Alert
Plays the Adhan at prayer time — even when ILMORA is in background. A silent keeper keeps alerts alive after you close the screen. For best results: set ILMORA/Chrome to "Unrestricted battery" and allow Autostart in your phone settings.
Push Notifications
Order updates, new products & announcements — even when the app is closed. In the Android app, open ILMORA in Chrome once and tap Allow there.
